ad_text_used: In a hotel room, two young men sit on a bed, shirtless, with a box of doughnuts beside them. One of the men, who has a tattoo of footprints and calligraphy on his chest, talks animatedly to the camera while eating a doughnut. He gestures with his hands, emphasizing his words, and occasionally shows a close-up of the doughnut. The atmosphere is relaxed and informal as they discuss the number of doughnuts they have eaten.
